journey.name: Browse today's moments
journey.description: The Moments tab lists the server's detections, newest first, and can be narrowed to one camera.

actions.action: Clear the server URL field and type http://10.0.2.2:8971, type admin as the username and correct-horse as the password, then tap "Connect"
Verify that "Moments" is selected in the bottom navigation and a list of detections is shown, the first of them a person at the Front Door
Tap the camera filter chip (it reads "All cameras") and choose "Driveway"
Verify that only Driveway detections are listed and that a car is among them
